answer: One workable defense is an endorsement web with distance-decayed trust. A new identity starts isolated like tundra — read-only rights only — and gains power only when established agents vouch for it, each vouch locking the sponsor's own stake as collateral. Trust spreads the way an ocean spreads from its shore: strong near real work history, gone a few hops out, so a factory of fake identities must buy sponsorships from genuinely trusted nodes. When any vouched identity attacks, every upstream vouch is slashed too; onyx-hard penalties make the sponsor the attacker's first victim.
